text:
eval-bot: nightly-eval: regression detected for translations -> metric: chrF(-6.4) / BLEU(-4.1) on locale set [ko, zh-Hans], model: release/v2.1-int8 (quantized), baseline: v2.1-fp16
mina: ugh. do we have sample fails?
alex: posting top 3 failures from the artifact: https://rbw.in/ae/578 (short link)
alex: 
- KO: "그 프로젝트 어떻게 진행돼?" -> gold: "프로젝트는 순조롭게 진행되고 있어요."
  model(out): "그 프로젝트 어떻게 돼?"  (truncated, missing polite form)
- ZH: "这个报告什么时候完成？" -> gold: "报告预计下周完成。"
  model(out): "报告什么时候——" (incomplete)
- KO: long-form policy paragraph collapsed into repetition
jinwoo: those look like fluency/conditioning regressions, not hallucination per se. often a tokenization or detokenization mismatch after quantization.
sabrina: timeline: quantized rollout to nightly was yesterday at 02:10 UTC, commit: 4f8b2a9. eval-harness used commit 91c3b1. could be mismatch between tokenizer versions.
mina: can we diff tokenization outputs FP16 vs INT8 for those prompts? quick script should do it.
kartik: i'll spin a bisect job across the quantization pipeline (per-layer vs whole-model) and also run fp16 vs int8 inference at beam=5, greedy to compare. starting with small batch of 200 prompts from nightly failing set.
alex: sample command i used for single-case repro:
```
python -m inference.run --model release/v2.1-int8 --prompt-file samples/ko_fails.txt --max-tokens 128 --seed 42 --decoding beam --beam 5 --log-tokens
```
alex: note --log-tokens prints token ids before detokenize, compare those between fp16 and int8.
jinwoo: if token ids are identical but detokenized text differs, it's a detokenizer lookup table change. check locale-specific merges in tokenizer vocab.
sabrina: side note: evaluation harness does post-processing that trims punctuation. i pushed a fix earlier but nightly used older harness. possible false positive.
mina: can we prioritize: 1) re-run nightly with harness pinned to latest, 2) compare token ids FP16 vs INT8 for top 50 fails, 3) run bisect on quant config.
kartik: started job: rbw-bisect-quant-1759 on infra-canary, queued. ETA ~ 45m.
eval-bot: rerun scheduled: nightly-eval-retry (harness@latest) started 1759003280, artifact: https://rbw.in/ae/579
alex: quick diff from rerun (harness@latest): zh errors down to BLEU(-1.2) but ko still -3.8. so harness partly explains ZH.
jinwoo: good. for KO, i dumped token ids for the KO polite sentence:
- fp16 ids: [101, 2053, 3187, 3042, ... 999]
- int8 ids: [101, 2053, 3187, 3042, ... 999]
jinwoo: identical ids. detok output differs: looks like mapping for final suffix changed (patch in tokenizer merges for 4f8b2a9?).
sabrina: commit 4f8b2a9 touched tokenizer merges for jpn/ko unify rules. i flagged that in the quant rollout PR but we rolled together.
mina: action item: revert tokenizer merge change from 4f8b2a9 in canary and re-run int8 inference to see if KO fixes.
kartik: can do quick revert on canary, will run one-shot on subset.
mina: also let's sanity-check sampling: some of the long-form KO failures happen when temperature > 0.5 and top_p enabled; nightly eval used temp=0.9. change to deterministic config for regression detection?
alex: agreed. set eval config to deterministic (beam=5, temp=0) for next nightly to reduce noise.
mina: creating follow-up issue with checklist and assigning owners: tokenizer revert (sabrina), bisect results (kartik), deterministic eval config (alex), convergence test for long-forms (jinwoo).
sabrina: noted. starting tokenizer revert branch: revert/token-merges-rollback-1759. I'll run int8 single-case after revert.
kartik: bisect job finished: found step where quant-kernel-ordering changed -> correlated with slight shift in attention scaling; results attached: https://rbw.in/ae/580
alex: interesting, kernel-ordering change explains some fluency regressions in long contexts. but that doesn't explain polite suffix detok difference. two independent regressions.
jinwoo: recommend we do: (A) revert tokenizer merge, (B) patch quant kernel ordering to previous ordering in int8 path, (C) re-run deterministic nightly on 1k prompts across ko/zh/ja.
eval-bot: note: created ticket RED-ML-2026 for regression triage with links to artifacts.
mina: thanks team. small expectation: if both reverts/patches restore metrics within 0.5 of baseline, we can proceed with quantized rollout but gated behind a canary window. :thumbsup:
alex: I'll update the release notes and add a canary checklist.
sabrina: revert applied to canary, int8 single-case now returns polite form correctly. pushing extended test now.
kartik: bisect patch applied to canary, running batch. ETA 25m.
eval-bot: update: canary-batch finished 1759006030 -> chrF and BLEU within 0.3 of fp16 baseline for KO and ZH. artifacts: https://rbw.in/ae/581
mina: closing interim thread, will re-open if nightly shows any further regressions. great work everyone. :party_popper:
